We studied the price competition of two-echelon supply chains that exists crossed structure, and compared price and profit in three different scenario, which consist of manufacturer as Stackelberg leader (MS) scenario, retailer as Stackelberg leader(RS) scenario, and decentralized decision(DD) scenario between manufacture and retailer. We prove that competition is most dramatic in DD scenario, and least in MS scenario. Finally, we discussed the influence of different parameters to price decision of members in supply chains.

articleTitle: The coordination of production and distribution scheduling in mass customization
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: A critical issue in supply chain management is coordinating the decisions made by decision makers at different stages. Traditional scheduling see production scheduling as the dominant, and distribution have to follow it, but this leads to inventory cost and delivery tardiness. So, we study the coordinating of production and distribution scheduling in MC. The overall problem is decomposed into two sub-problems, which consists of distribution allocation problem and a single manufacture's production scheduling problem, then see the distribution allocation as the main part, production scheduling coordinate to it. Then set up mixed integer programming models, the models proposed to minimize supply chain total cost encompass distribution cost, production cost, delivery lateness cost and the inventory holding cost, and different constraints and assumptions have been taken into consideration in our modeling. In the end, we propose the genetic algorithms approach, and numerical examples are presented to illustrate the model and the approach.

articleTitle: Research on the relationship between enterprise control and performance
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The performance of an enterprise is greatly influenced by its management capacity. From the aspect of management theory, control is a function of management. This paper was based on the control lever theory created by Robert Simons, Firstly proposed the conception of enterprise control power and worked out an indicators system of enterprise control power, then designed the questionnaire and researched 16 machinery and equipment manufacturing industry enterprises in the region of Harbin, analyzed the relationship between the enterprise control, the essence function of management, and the performance. Through investigation this paper proved that enterprise control has a positive influence on the performance. Finally this study gave out the strategies of how to improve the organization performance by using the control tools.

articleTitle: On methods of decision-making under interval probabilities
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Decision-making problems are generally classified into three types traditionally: certain one, uncertain one and risky one according to the decision-makers' information of states which they are facing. However there are some decision-making problems lying out of the classification scheme. Interval probabilities were presented to describe these situations and were developed to be a general theory to describe uncertainties and completeness in decision-makings. And to convert interval probabilities to point probabilities is generally accepted way to solve decision makings under interval probabilities. Our focus is mainly on how to convert interval probabilities to point probabilities. Three methods, computer simulation method, linear analytical method and maximum entropy method are put forward to convert interval probabilities to point probabilities, which make decision-makings under interval probabilities can be solved by the classical EMV principle. And their advantages and disadvantages are discussed by the end.

articleTitle: An improved heuristic algorithm for the problem of inventory —transportation integrated optimization
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: VMI (vendor managed inventory) policy coordinates effectively the antinomy between the inventory and the transportation within logistics distribution system. Under VMI mode, integrating inventory and transportation of the supplier and the demander as a whole is considered to achieve the optimization of total distribution cost. In view of typical one-warehouse multiretailer distribution network in the modern distribution logistics system, the mathematic model on the inventory-transportation integrated optimization problem with stochastic demand and many products is established by using a bilevel programming method; and an improved heuristic algorithm is designed to solve the problem; and then, numerical examples are given to show that the inventory-transportation integrated optimization between the supplier and the demander makes for decreasing total cost of distribution system.

articleTitle: The impact of corporation social responsibility on relational benefit: The perspective of brand image
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Relational benefit is the key of relationship marketing. Exploring the source of relational benefits has great theories and practical value. This paper explores the affect mechanism between corporation social responsibility and relational benefit. Firstly, we find consumer perceived corporation social responsibility consists of product responsibility, environment responsibility and social responsibility. Secondly, we investigate the relationship among corporation social responsibility, brand image and relational benefit by structure equation model. Findings indicate that brand perceived quality, brand personality image and brand social image, have positive and significant effect on confidence benefit, identity-related relational benefit and honor benefit. Product responsibility has positive impact on brand perceived quality. Environment responsibility has positive impact on brand personality image and brand social image. And social responsibility has positive impact on all the three dimensions of brand image. Implications for theory and management are discussed in the last section.

articleTitle: Studying on Choice of R&D Cooperation Patterns for electronic information enterprises based on logit model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on Logit model, the paper studies on the Choice of R&D Cooperation Patterns on electronic information small and middle size enterprises in Beijing. It analyzes the characteristics of the patters on R&D cooperation and the patterns that what kind of enterprise would properly choose. It discusses the type and influencing factors for R&D cooperation patterns, and puts forward advice that the enterprise chooses the appropriate R&D cooperation patterns combined with its own characteristics. Then the paper sets up the index system for evaluation for the empirical study. Finally, the results show that different enterprises would choose different R&D cooperation patterns considering specific influencing factors. And the choice for the R&D cooperation patterns will be affected by the nature of the electronic information enterprises.

articleTitle: Spatial econometric analysis on the impact of knowledge spillovers on regional innovative output —A case of high technology industry
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Using a spatial econometric model to carry out the econometric analysis on three kinds of knowledge spillovers effects on innovative output and spatial dependence based on a case of high technology industry. As a result of the spatial econometric regression to the innovative output of China's provincial regions and knowledge spillovers was found that the innovative activity of China's 31 provincial regions have spatial dependence, and the specialization and diversity of the high technology industry, and provincial regional human capital has the contribution to the innovative output.

articleTitle: Debt financing, loan market structure and enterprise investment decisions based on real option
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: In the uncertain economic environment, being the major source of project capital, debt financing can affect the firm's investment efficiency. In this paper we analyze the impact of debt financing on irreversible investment using real option method, and analyze numerically the impact of debt financing level and uncertainty on the investment trigger and option value under different loan market structures. Compared with the unlevered firm and the levered firm in the competitive loan market, the levered firm in the imperfectly competitive loan market waits to the higher investment trigger to undertake the investment for lack of money. The higher the bargaining power of the bank, the higher the coupon charged, the higher the investment trigger but the lower the value of waiting to invest.

articleTitle: Integrated innovation the source of modern enterprise's competitive advantage
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Innovation is the source of enterprise's competitiveness. With the frequency of innovation getting more and more fast, the technology becoming more complex and technology development input getting harder, enterprise can no longer get competitiveness from the traditional single liner innovation. Only by integrated innovation which is self-reinforcing can enterprise become invincible. In this paper, we first review the innovation theory and the five kinds of innovation models, and then introduce the meaning and features of integrated innovation. At last we analyze how enterprise gets sustained competitiveness from integrated innovation.

articleTitle: An empirical study on the effect of information system innovation usage on performance: Based on the innovation climate perspective
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Enterprises increasingly have to depend on the innovation behaviors to get the best organizational performance from information systems. The objective of this paper is to contribute to a deeper understanding of information system innovation usage in enterprises by examining its effect to enterprise performance and its determinant factors. Based on the organizational innovation climate and exploitation & exploration innovation theories from organizational management literature, the paper develops a research model of information system innovation usage. Then with the questionnaires from approximately two hundreds enterprises in Chinese economy, this proposed model is empirically tested. Research results show that organizational innovational climate is positively associated with two types of information system innovation usage, and exploitation of information system innovation usage influence on short-term performance, and exploration of information system innovation usage influence on long-term performance. Some implications are given in the end of paper.

articleTitle: Relations and strategies of Chinese textile and apparel enterprises: A global value chain perspective
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper explored the current real situation of apparel value chain in China at the level of firms, and analyzed the roles of different sectors in apparel value chain, including yarn producers, integrated producers and apparel producers etc., as well as the rules among them. Specifically, it focused on the relations and strategies of Chinese textile and apparel enterprises on the basis of questionnaire survey and in-depth interview, and further divided enterprises into 2 groups, namely initiative enterprises and passive enterprises, according to their attitudes in the above areas, therefore competitiveness could be compared between them. Finally it concluded that for most Chinese enterprises, though it is hard to change the status in global apparel value chain in short term, stronger forward and backward linkages and initiative strategies could help to capture more gains and run a better business in global production network.

articleTitle: The relationship between industrial structure optimization and financial support based on Co-integration analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the data of 1978-2007, the relationship between financial support and the industrial structure optimization in the northeast China is discussed by Co-integration analysis and Granger Causality Test. We can conclude from the results of the empirical analysis that there exists long-term dynamic equilibrium interrelation, and that there is one-way Granger Causality between the two, namely financial support is indispensable to the industrial structure optimization in northeast China, which is helpful to the economy development and decision-making of the government.

articleTitle: Study on time change relevancy of China stock market
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The article examines daily market index data of China stock markets from 1998 to 2008, and analyses fluctuation link trend between two regions' stock markets. Through Johansen co-integration test and Granger causality test, the paper finds the link between Shanghai and Shenzhen stock markets and Hong Kong stock market has become more closely linked and integration trend is remarkable. The strong relevancy effectively reduces risk by making diversified investment in two regions.

articleTitle: A moderation model of political behavior
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The study tests a moderation model of political behavior. Specifically, we propose that an individual's perceptions of organizational politics (POPs) influence his or her own political behavior engagement, while the POPs-political behavior linkage varies across different individual political skill levels. For those politically skilled individuals, the POPs-political behavior relationship will be positively stronger. In the model we also specify the positive effect of political behavior on his or her promotion in the organization. To test the model, a sample that included 157 civil servants is collected. Regression analyses on the sample show that both POPs and political skill are positively related to political behavior; POPs and political skill complement each other to influence political behavior, which can, in turn, help the civil servant get more promotion opportunities. Theoretical and practical implications of the results are discussed.

articleTitle: Dynamic multiattribute decision making based on the intuitionistic fuzzy priority rating model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper studies the dynamic decision-making problem in the intuitionistic fuzzy environment. For the decision matrix composed by intuitionistic fuzzy numbers, the intuitionistic fuzzy priority rating model is established to determine the membership relation of each alternative to the excellent alternative set, which is also described by intuitionistic fuzzy number. Furthermore, based on the score and accuracy degree of intuitionistic fuzzy number, the alternatives are ranked in view of the various risk attitude of the decision maker. An illustrative example is analyzed to demonstrate the feasibility and practicability of the proposed model in the end. The method proposed in this paper can make full use of the indeterminate information involved in the decision matrices, and is easy to understand and calculate.

articleTitle: A study of the effect of managerial entrenchment on CEO turnover in Chinese listed companies
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The removal of poorly performing managers is a crucial mechanism by which owners maximize firm performance. However, managerial entrenchment can reduce the threat of CEO removal, even with evidence of poor performance. Managerial entrenchment refers to the extent to which fail to experience discipline from the full range of corporate governance and control mechanism. The presence of this extent reduces the restrictions on managers by stockholders' dismissing or markets' competing in corporate control, results to effect of managerial entrenchment. It is found in the empirical research that the higher the managerial entrenchment, the less possible the CEO turnover; the sensitivity of managers to corporate performance decreases with the increasing entrenchment level. Further examination by regression shows that there is difference in the effect of different entrenchment levels on managerial turnover. CEO turnover is less sensitive to performance in sample companies of high-level entrenchment; CEO turnover is more sensitive to performance in sample companies of low-level entrenchment.

articleTitle: A supplier classification method based on fuzzy multi-attribute group decision-making
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Moving from a single decision-maker to a group of decision-makers introduces a great deal of complexity into the analysis. The problem is no longer the selection of the most preferred alternative among the non-dominated solution according to one individual's preferred structure. Firstly, the supplier selection, evaluation and management have become the key factors affecting the market competitiveness in the future. And, the supplier selection is the base. For the selection of the most preferred supplier, this paper proposes a new fuzzy multi-attribute group decision-making method, which takes into account the preferred uncertainty in decision-making and uses the weighted Hamming distance. Furthermore the classification of the suppliers was attained by their closeness coefficient region. Finally, an example was presented to prove the simple and feasible of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The estimation of personal competence of project group by methods of linear programming
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper deals with the personal competence of the group using linear programming. Any organisation exists for achievement its own goals and proposes. The organizational purposes are reached by the teamwork of all personnel. The success of the organisation mostly depends on its managerial part of the personnel. Therefore the correct estimation and selection compatible and effective staff is the main aspect of competitive advantage. Especially it is important when organisation introduce the matrix structures which correspond with the modern conception of management. Matrix structures also are effective in the conditions of more and more growing level of competition. As is known, when organisation use the matrix structure inside it must be created the temporary groups for performance of any project, i.e. the teams which must includes specialists in various areas. This team should be balanced for the effective decision of a problem. It is impossible, if all team consists only of leaders or only of creative persons who are worse adapted for management of a team. Performance qualities of managerial work are too hard to estimate adequately. Therefore it's necessary to estimate personal characteristics instead of performance qualities for selection of a corresponding team and for creation of a new motivational stimulus to staff's self-improvement.

articleTitle: Evolution game analysis of knowledge-sharing based on organization knowledge structure
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Knowledge sharing is evolutionary dynamic process within organizations. This paper use evolutionary game theory to study the dynamics of knowledge sharing. First, organization knowledge structure was analyzed according to the organization members' knowledge sets. Based on organization knowledge structure, knowledge sharing game is classed into four types, which are intersection, disjoint, superposition, inclusion, etc. Then, the replicator dynamics of knowledge sharing is built, and evolutionary stable strategy (ESS) of knowledge-sharing are analyzed. Results show that, to achieve high-level organization knowledge-sharing, the share strategy must be ESS and the initial state of organization must be in the stable region of ESS. Organization can adjust their knowledge structure and use proper excitation methods to get a well initial state for a high level of knowledge sharing.

articleTitle: Research on regulation and the timing of financial product innovation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Financial regulation has an important impact on financial product innovation activities. Through the establishment of a game model between regulator and innovator, this paper studies the relationship between regulatory delay and the timing of financial product innovation. The conclusion is that regulatory delay has positively impact on the innovator's decision. The impact is good or bad depending on the regulation direct cost and the opportunity cost.

articleTitle: Research on customer operation mode
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Customers are the most important assets of enterprise. In the era of customer economy, customers are becoming the core of competitive focus, and the value of enterprise is decided by customers. The enterprise should turn their operating object from product to customer, and apply customer operation mode. Customer operation mode can be defined as an operating innovation that enterprise take customers as operating object, equip with resource around customers, acquire customer lifetime value through applying customer satisfactory tactics, and make enterprise acquire sustainable customer competitive superiority. Compared with product operation mode, the main content, characteristic and advantages of customer operation mode are introduced in this paper. The drivers of customer value and the best type of customer operation mode are analyzed. The tactics of customer operation mode are presented and some constructive suggestions on how to carry out customer operation mode for enterprise are proposed. The result of this paper can help enterprise apply customer operation mode and acquire sustainable customer competitive superiority.

articleTitle: Portfolio choice over the life-cycle for Chinese residents with risky housing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: We develop a dynamic realistically calibrated life-cycle model to study the optimal portfolio choice for Chinese families with risky housing. We try to find the relationships between household asset allocation and its housing decision, and the effect of housing transaction cost, housing price incremental rate and the lowest level of housing. Our analysis demonstrates that the home ownership rate and housing position are hump-shaped during life-cycle. It means that some households may optimal choose to sell their house, and become renters again at the latter stage of life-cycle. Our analysis also indicate that housing transaction cost crowds out of stockholdings because of protective saving, and housing price incremental rate and the lowest level of housing reduces stockholdings due to the illiquid home equity restrictions.

articleTitle: Empirical study on the quality of financial accounting information's impact on economic performance
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper uses the evaluation for listed companies' disclosure level by Shenzhen stock exchange as the agency variable of financial accounting information quality, including listed firms in Shenzhen stock exchange from 2002 to 2006 as our sample, empirically tests the relation between the quality of financial accounting information and economic performance, and the paper also tests if financial accounting information affects economic performance through corporate governance system channel. Empirical results show high-quality financial accounting information does improve economic performance and corporate governance is one of the channels, regardless of Tobin's Q or return on assets or ratio of net operating cash flow to assets as the agency variable of economic performance. But we don't empirically test if there are other channels through which financial accounting information can promote economic performance, this may be one direction we want to research about in future. Therefore higher-quality financial accounting information is of great significance for economic performance.

articleTitle: Complex dynamics of a duopoly game model with bounded rationality and heterogeneous product
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the author first introduces studies on duopoly game models and points out the deficiencies of these models. Then a new duopoly game model with bounded rationality and differentiated product is constructed. The author then analyzes the complex dynamics of this model, giving the condition which ensures the existence of Nash equilibrium, showing that the extent of product substitution and the speeds of production adjustment of these firms can determine whether the game can reach Nash equilibrium or not, even lead to chaos, So the firms in the duopoly game have to adjust their reaction speeds continuously, and manage to make the product substitution factor small enough in order to maintain the stability of Nash equilibrium to get the maximum profits, and avoid the occurrence of chaos.

articleTitle: Educational technologies for forming an intellectual activities in the innovation management and business
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Professional training of businessmen and managers in universities and corporative schools tends to solve the main question. It deals with formation and development of intellectual activity and managing intellect. This education problem solution represents a response to modern economy knowledge challenge.

articleTitle: Diffusion model and empirical analysis of China-Brazil Earth Resource Satellite image
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Applications Satellite Industry is national strategic high-tech industry, and the key tache for its industrialization is to deepen Image diffusion in more economic and social fields. Based on the market structure and diffusion process of CBERS (China-Brazil Earth Resource Satellite) image, this paper analyses the characteristics of distribution and establishes three diffusion models of network channels, price strategies and competitive factors respectively. Empirical result shows speed of diffusion is fastened through online channel, but hampered by TM Image, and free distribution policy has no obvious impact on it. It is cost-efficient that influence the decision of potential adopter deeply. Further research takes all three factors into the nested model, and gives the simplest form including network factor and the most accurate form including network and competition factors.

articleTitle: Energy types regional ecological restoration decision-making models and empirical studies
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: With large-scale energy development, the ecological environment of the energy types regional is polluted and damaged seriously. The survival of cities that mainly exploit resources has become a focus of all society. The question that how to recover the ecological environment in this region remains to be solved. The energy types regional ecological restoration must have a qualitative and quantitative analysis for various ecological restoration factors and their mutual relationship, clear their relationship, choose a reasonable eco-restoration scheme, This article constructs the energy types regional ecological recovery decision-making model on the base of the analysis of energy types regional ecological restoration system and use the model to study the scheme of Hegang ecological restoration.

articleTitle: A study on the coordination mode for closed-loop supply chain with risk preference
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The coordination of closed-loop supply chain with risk preference in stochastic demand is studied. Both the market demand is price sensitive and the stochastic demand which possibly exists in reality are considered, and the profit function is no longer being taken as a decision-making but the utility function with the risk preferences of manufacturers and retailers is used in calculating. The retailer take recycling model is analyzed to construct a Stackelberg game model for closed-loop supply chain where the manufacturers play the role of leader while the retailers play the role of followers. The Stackelberg equilibrium game is proposed on a basis of decentralized decision which is discussed in relation to centralized decision. The possibility of the existence of a coordinative strategy is also discussed for the closed-loop supply chain. Finally a simulation computing is completed to verify that the method of modeling is available.

articleTitle: Corporate governance, investment behavior and stock returns
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on agency theory of the firm, and the special institutional setting that China corporate governance evolve from mandatory governance in ldquocompliancerdquo stage to voluntary governance in ldquoinnovationrdquo stage, this paper analyses how voluntary governance affect stock returns under the research paradigm of ldquogovernance mechanism-corporate behavior-economic consequences rdquo. Subsequently, apply positive tests by using the data on China's listed companies data from 2005 to 2007. We find that, investor relations and stock returns significantly correlated, and ways to achieve by the mediator variable for investment behavior. The study found explore the specific channel of corporate governance affect the economic consequences, open the ldquoblack boxesrdquo between them, and provide a useful perspective of the understanding of corporate governance affect economic consequences.

articleTitle: Crop area yield risk evaluation and premium rates calculation —Based on nonparametric kernel density estimation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Nonparametric method is used in this paper to evaluate the Probability density of relative meteorological yield in 19 provinces of China based on historical yields of rice, corn, wheat and bean per acre from 1985 to 2007, and yield risk also be estimated on the basis of normal density. After figuring out relative meteorological yield distribution, this paper calculates premium rates of 19 provinces for different coverage level. After comparing results of this two methods, it shows that about 56% nonparametric rates are larger than normal rates and in most cases (75%), means of nonparametric rates are significantly different from that of normal rates according to the paired t-test. The premium rates may be underestimated with the assumption of normal distribution. Implications for rating area yield crop insurance are discussed, which contains that there should be large enough percent of farmers to buy the insurance products.

articleTitle: The management evaluation of animal welfare based on Triangular Fuzzy Number Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper, based on the forty-three indicators of animal physiology welfare, including environmental welfare, health welfare, mental welfare and behavioral welfare , totally five aspects as the subject, established the evaluation model of animal welfare management in zoos, and used triangular fuzzy number analytic hierarchy process to draw the weights of various evaluation factors, the results indicates that physical welfare, environmental welfare, health welfare, mental welfare and behavioral welfare in the respective weights are 0.251,0.222,0.179,0.182,0.166; Through the applicated evaluation of the welfare in Heilongjiang Northeast Tiger Animals Garden, it indicates that Heilongjiang Northeast Tiger Garden of animal welfare is in good conditions and is in line with the actual situation, which illustrates this method can be used in evaluation of zoo animal welfare management.

articleTitle: A new method for market potential assessment on emerging technology products and its positive analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Many researchers have done great jobs in the study of the assessment of future market potential of emerging technology products, and it has been one of the research hotspots in the field of MOT, while there are still not convincing methods that can complete the systematic analysis from the research results. This study presents a systematic analysis method that combing the subjective and objective methods of market potential assessment and analyzing the matching up of the technology supply and market requirements, and this is expected to be the comprehensive assess method and with great practical value. We also assess the future market potential of tubular skylight system as the specific example, and we get the match degree between the tubular skylight system and the market demand product in the end.

articleTitle: The bi-level programming model between the manufacture and the supplier
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: We consider a serial supply chain consisting of a supplier and a manufacturer, where production, inventory, transportation, backlogging and subcontracting decisions are integrated. A sequence of deterministic but non-stationary demands of the manufacturer for single good needs to be satisfied by the supplier over a finite horizon. In each period, the supplier can produce items by himself; also can use the subcontracting option if he can not satisfy the manufacturer's need, or due to the cost consideration. Generally, manufacturer's order decisions can influence the supplier's profits straightly, and on the contrary, supplier's plan of production also can influence the cost of manufacturer. Hence, it is not appropriate to take them as one group with public benefit sometimes. We establish a bi-level programming model in which the manufacturer is the leader, the supplier is the follower and the production and subcontracting capacities are stationary. The manufacturer as the leader, first gives the decisions of ordering, aiming to reduce the cost of himself, then the follower-supplier, decides his plan of production or subcontracting according to the manufacture's order to minimize his own cost. By solving the model, we can get the relative optimal schemes satisfied by both of the manufacturer and the supplier.

articleTitle: Analysis on the implementation model of intelligent knowledge management based on data mining
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The development and application of data mining technology puts forward new requirement to knowledge management in information era. Intelligent knowledge is the valuable knowledge that comes from data mining technology, and has the intelligent features such as memory, recognition, self-updating, disappearance etc after the transaction by man-machine interaction. On the basis of analyzing the goals and layers of intelligent knowledge management, this paper studies the implementation model of intelligent knowledge management from the aspects of its cultivation, expression and storage, audit and logic mechanism etc. It will afford new perspective for research on knowledge management.

articleTitle: A development on lot streaming with supplier-manufacturer coordination
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we extend Li and Xiao (2004)'s study by relaxing the assumption of the transportation cost between each pair of parties in a supply chain is fixed and independent of shipment size. With the analysis, we find that the supplier's optimal decision with considering near-realistic transportation cost is more differing from that with fixed transportation cost. Accordingly, the coordination mechanism between the supplier and the manufacturer is changed to be more complex.

articleTitle: Fiscal decentralization and urban-rural income inequality in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: China carried two important fiscal decentralization reforms in 1985 and 1994 respectively. The first one is contract fiscal system and the second one is tax-sharing system. Local government undertakes the responsibility of public goods provision for local areas when they get the financial autonomy after the fiscal decentralization. The criterion of the political evaluation mechanism is economic growth in China after the economic reform. So, local government officials invest most of the fiscal fund in industry because of the difference in investment return rates between agriculture and industry. Industry concentrates in urban areas and contributes to the increase of income level of urban residents. So, fiscal decentralization leads to the increase of urban-rural income inequality. Empirical analysis results of panel data of Chinese provinces during 1979-2004 show that fiscal decentralization promotes the urban-rural income inequality.

articleTitle: Efficiency evaluation of provincial input-output based on DEA in rural China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) is an effective measure tool to evaluate the regional input-output efficiency. After the brief review of existing literature, as well as the principle of DEA, this paper evaluates the input-output efficiency of China's 31 provinces (municipality) via the approach of DEA. The result shows that there are respectively three, one and three provinces from east, center to west are efficient in rural input-output. Moreover, the average efficiencies of the three regions are very close, and the effect of different region is not significant to rural input-output.

articleTitle: Coordinating supply chain contracts with fuzzy demand
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: In a two-stage supply chain composed of one supplier and one retailer, the supply chain coordination mechanism in fuzzy demand environment is researched. The market demands are regarded as fuzzy variable. The models of centralized decision-making, the return contract and revenue sharing contract are built based on credibility distribution and their optimal policies are also proposed under uncertain theory. Finally, take the triangular fuzzy numbers as an example, a numerical is given to illustrate the models and analyze the influence of parameters on the models. It shows that the contracts can coordinate the supply chain with fuzzy demand. The different wholesale price and return price tactics in return contract, and the different wholesale price in revenue sharing contract can be got by using different parameters. The fuzzy expected value of the profit for each actor in return contract can be equaled with that in revenue sharing contract by offered certain contract parameters.

articleTitle: Analysis of influencing factors on the enterprise TMT strategic decision-making from the perspective of mechanics
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: For its strategic importance, this article is directed at a special core decision group in the enterprise called top management team (TMT) which plays a vital role in the improvement of the enterprise's core competitiveness and performance. This article abstracts diverse factors which have an impact on TMT strategic decision-making into a force from the perspective of mechanics, which will analyze the impact of various factors more intuitively and effectively. The aim is to depict a picture of comprehensive, dynamic and external competitive environment and internal operating environment for TMT, which can provide reliable information to enable the TMT to fully and accurately assess their own competitive ability and various opportunities and threats hiding in the external environment, consequently to lay the foundation of developing and implementing the right strategy, creating and maintaining a sustainable competitive advantage for enterprise.

articleTitle: A new modified DEA model for distinguishing efficient decision making units
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The efficiency evaluation value which is provided by C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>R model of data envelopment analysis (DEA) can be used for ranking decision making units (DMUs), however, this ranking procedure does not yield relative rankings for those units with 100% efficiency. Some researchers have proposed a modified efficiency measure for efficient units which can be used for ranking, but this ranking breaks down in some cases, and can be unstable when one of the DMUs has a relatively small value for some of its inputs. To solve the problems of distinguishing efficient DMUs and unreasonable input and output weights in traditional C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>R model of DEA, a modified DEA model (MC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>R) for distinguishing DMUs is set up in this paper by introducing two virtual DMUs. The common weights vector is computed and then all DMUs are distinguished and ranked with the modified model. The result of an example proves that our new model can differentiate the efficient DMUs in C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>R model and give a more reasonable evaluation.

articleTitle: Effects of trust in subordinate and system control on leader empowering behavior: Empirical study from China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The present study addressed the antecedents of leader empowering behavior that was overlooked in previous studies, by proposing and empirically testing the relationship of trust in subordinate and system control with leader empowering behavior. The survey data was from a total of 567 matched leader-subordinate dyads. The result of hierarchical regression analysis indicated that both of trust in subordinate and system control were positively related to three dimensions of leader empowering behaviors, involving participative decision, informing and coaching. Moreover, system control had significant moderating effects on the relationship of trust in subordinate and three dimensions of leader empowering behavior. In specifically, the relationship between trust in subordinate and leader empowering behavior will be stronger for those lower in system control. At last, the theoretical and practice implications of the present study were discussed.

articleTitle: Study on the index system for evaluating the competitive performance of coal enterprises in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Coal industry plays very important role in the healthy development of economy. It has its own specialness in the process of development, for example, the efficient use of coal recourses has great importance to its existence and to the sustainable development of the whole world. This paper analyses the influence factors of coal enterprise competition strategy, based on which the paper constructs the performance evaluation index system of the coal enterprise competition strategy, and puts forward the method to evaluate the performance, namely, we determine index weight using entropy method and evaluate the performance using the method of principal component projection. We look forward to using what we did to provide the guidance and reference for improving the competitive and performance level of coal enterprises. At the end of the paper some suggestions have been put forward including the way to green development.

articleTitle: The relationship research among organizational commitment, employee satisfaction and work performance
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This study used questionnaires, released 243 copies questionnaires in Shaanxi Province, carried out correlation analysis and multiple stepwise regression analysis on survey quantified results by SPSS software. This study explored the mutual relationships among the three factors: organizational commitment, employee satisfaction, work performance in Shaanxi enterprise, pointed that there is significant positive correlation among organizational commitment, employee satisfaction, and work performance. We found that organizational commitment and employee satisfaction affect work performance directly and positively, and while work performance exerts a positive and direct influence on organizational commitment and employee satisfaction. And then based on the findings of the study, we put forward relevant recommendations as the reference to enterprises management, so as to establish better organizational atmosphere, improve the staffs' work attitude and enhance their job performance.

articleTitle: Empirical analysis on determinants of the county level economic growth in China's central region
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The county level economies play an important role in China. In the central region of China, these economies account for a large share though their development is slow. To some extent, the difference between the central and eastern regions of China is mainly due to the disparity between the county level economies. Hence, growth in the county level economies is vital to economic development of China's central region. The objective of this article is to examine the determinants of economic growth at the county level. The analysis is based on the pooled data of 498 counties in the central region for the period of 2000-2006. The results show that investment, human capital and urbanization are positively related with county level economic growth, while the effects of labor input, fiscal expenditure and household savings are negative. Moreover, the location of counties also has remarkable influences on economic growth.

articleTitle: Study on credit sale risk assessing model based on credit sale risk degree
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: In view of the nature of credit sales risk, the credit sale risk degree is put forward as a new standard to measure the credit sale risk in the paper. It is calculated by customers' average loan recovery rate and it can not only tell whether the loss will happen but also can measure the specific extent of the loss. So this standard has three advantages of directness, continuity and operability. According to the proposed standard, the credit sale risk is divided into five grades and a credit sale risk assessing model based on support vector machine (SVM) is established in the paper. The empirical analysis shows that the proposed model is feasible and accurate for measuring the risk of sale on credit.

articleTitle: Recent development in research on employee commitment
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Research on employee commitment continues to be popular despite early reports of the non-significant and at best, moderate correlations between global organizational commitment and performance. The inclusion of the motives and foci of employee commitment in commitment-performance studies have revealed more statistically significant relationships between the two constructs. This paper provides an overview of the different motives and domains or targets of employee commitment and highlights the importance of using affective rather than normative or continuance commitment measures in research. In addition, it discusses the weaknesses in using the organizational commitment questionnaire (OCQ) as a measure of organizational commitment.

articleTitle: Coordination and ripple effect of a competitive supply chain based on quantity-discount contract
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper we investigate a competitive supply chain which consists of a supplier and two competitive manufacturers who produce substitutive goods. We will examine whether a common wholesale price contract can coordinate a competitive supply chain in our paper. We conclude that this kind of contract does not work. So, we turn to a quantity-discount contract. In this contract, we discuss a decentralized decision of the supply chain at first. We find that the ripple effect of the whole supply chain is various when coefficient of discount k is among different ranges. Next, we consider that when, the supply chain can be coordinated. That is, the optimal value of supply chain on the decentralized decision equals the one on the centralized decision. Nevertheless, ripple effect still exists in the supply chain even if the chain is coordinated based on the quantity-discount contract. To some extent, the competitive advantage due to coordination of supply chain maybe weakened or even eliminated by this effect.

articleTitle: Research on the multiagent cooperation pattern in construction planning of large-scale construction programme
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: A multiagent cooperation pattern is used to research deeply the establishment, controlment and management of construction planning in the large-scale construction programme. At first the definitions of eight kinds of agents and the relationship between them are expatiated, and the construction planning of large-scale construction programme is established by using optimal dispatch principle. Then both top-down and bottom-up modeling approaches are used to discuss the multiagent cooperation pattern. At last heuristic resource allocation and knowledge-experience combination are separately used to solve problems in construction planning. Through the research of this paper, the definition, relationship, cooperation pattern and problem solving method of multiagent in construction planning of large-scale construction programme are proposed, and certain theory guide is provided for the distributed implementation and centralized management of large-scale construction programme.

articleTitle: Automatic remodeling of logistic business process in E-Logistic
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Electronic business has made logistics collaboration more and more important. Electronic logistic (e-logistic) as an open electronic platform can realize logistics collaboration. Workflow management system (WFMS) supports the operation of e-logistic. Exact logistic business process can ensure the normal running of WFMS. With the constantly change of logistic environment, logistic business process models don't keep stable. The large mount of process logs are saved in WFMS. These logs involve information of various logistic business processes. This paper researches an automatic remodeling method based on these logs. The core of the method is process remodeling algorithm. In the algorithm a Markov transition matrix is set up based on process logs. And according to the matrix the eight remodeling rules of process logical relations are designed. The remodeling method can not only automatically remodel the various logistic business processes, but also greatly enhance the process modeling efficiency.

articleTitle: The study of service model on Beijing rural solar energy products
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, according to the development of solar energy industries of Beijing rural areas in the present situation, we investigated the service models of the widespread products of solar energy, which were solar water heaters and solar street lamps, and analyzed the questions existing in the service of solar energy products. The study finds that establishing and perfecting the service model of solar energy products is the key to solve all the service questions and is also the basis of constructing the service system. Finally, this paper sets the special service providers of the solar energy products as the core objects, constructs the service system model of solar energy products and brings forward its five necessary functions of the model.

articleTitle: QoS ontology based efficient web services selection
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The ability to efficiently and effectively select the inter-organizational and heterogeneous services is the important support for the development of the Web service technology. Quality of service (QoS) profiles of Web services are crucial in determining which service best addresses the user desires and objectives. This paper developed a general QoS-based service selection method. By importing the proposed QoS ontology into OWL-S standards, the method can express Web service's nonfunctional attributes in a semantic and extensible way. Web service QoS based selection is formulated as a multi-criteria decision making (MCDM) which can be solved by using different MCDM models to evaluate QoS criteria of the candidate Web services. The values of quality parameters of a Web service are normalized to a non-negative real-valued number where higher normalized values represent higher levels of service performance. The proposed approach can be used as a solution for the complexity and reliability Web service selection problem.
